pass_conditions: All 18 startup source-hash inputs and the reviewed FILEdry plan/source bytes are sealed non-writable with a manifest whose SHA is checked by both controller and child.
A real sealed E2-R052a measured-or-not_met terminal, or a precise immutable waiver accepted by require_queue(), is present.
